name: Bent-Leg Trunk Twist

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: NHS Lower Back Pain Management Guidelines

steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and arms outstretched to the sides in a 'T' position.
Keeping your shoulders glued to the floor, slowly lower both knees to the right side toward the ground.
Pause in the gentle stretch for 2 to 3 seconds while exhaling deeply.
Engage your abdominal muscles to bring your knees back to the center position.
Slowly lower your knees to the left side and repeat the stretch.
coaching_cues: Keep both shoulder blades resting comfortably on the floor at all times.
Move smoothly within your pain-free range of motion—do not force your knees to the floor.
Let gravity assist the stretch gently.
